title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (3/20): Beijing Daxing International Airport
note_en: 人次 counts trips, not people: one traveler who flies twice counts as two 人次. So 客运量设计可以达到七千二百万人次 means the airport is designed for 72 million passenger trips a year, not 72 million different people. English usually blurs this by just saying "passengers," but Chinese statistics on travel, visits, and tickets use 人次 all the time.
